items.title: Historical arithmetic projection
items.summary: Candidate coordinate projection of elliptic-curve invariants; no bijection or physical law is established.
items.caveat: Coordinate units, scale, collisions, alpha and independently defined nulls remain subject to validation.

items.title: Independent mapping controls
items.summary: Alternative candidate map families prevent single-mapping selection from automatically implying a correspondence.
items.caveat: Identical samples, normalization and null distributions must be used before comparative claims.

items.title: Historical galaxy-bin L-series
items.summary: In the uploaded SFR report, a_n counts galaxies in three-dimensional bins of stellar mass, redshift and Petrosian radius.
items.caveat: An occupancy Dirichlet sum is not automatically an elliptic-curve L-function. Binning and ordering affect the construction.

items.title: Positivity and rank-inference limitation
items.summary: For a finite collection of nonnegative occupancies, a nonempty dataset implies the series is strictly positive at s=1.
items.caveat: Thus the stated series has no zero at s=1; a nonzero derivative does not establish rank 1 or an independent physical driver.
items.source: Direct mathematical check of uploaded SFR report sections 2.2-2.3

items.title: Proposed SFR features
items.summary: Historical additive hypothesis using SFR predictors motivated partly by the constructed cosmological series.
items.caveat: The same report states Random Forest optimization; this alone does not estimate coefficients of the displayed linear expression.

items.title: Historical five-fold SFR MSE
items.summary: The report lists fold MSEs 0.3904, 0.4312, 0.4420, 0.4322 and 0.4371.
items.caveat: Exact dataset version, fold membership, leakage-safe preprocessing, software and independent held-out accuracy are not verified.

items.title: Charter research architecture
items.summary: Research diagram illustrating the required order from mathematics to independent astronomical tests.
items.caveat: This is a workflow diagram, not a measured map of the cosmic web.

items.title: Persistent Betti-number interpretation
items.summary: Connected components, loops and cavities are filtration-dependent topological descriptors.
items.caveat: beta_1 is not a direct count of cosmic filaments and beta_2 is not automatically the number of observed voids.

items.title: Einstein-to-Weierstrass class-relative reduction
items.summary: A symbolic reduction is recorded for the registered Szekeres/Szafron Einstein-dust subclass.
items.caveat: Metric restrictions, regularity and external review remain; it is not independent proof of an ACSC cosmological mechanism.

items.title: Recovered CasJobs notebook saved output
items.summary: Historical notebook output derivative is available as inert archival provenance.
items.caveat: Not the complete notebook; source/query/result lineage remains partial. No notebook or serialized model is executed or loaded by the website.
